asked.item: Does Blotato check whether the mailbox exists before sending the link, e.g. for abc@abc.abc

verdict.reason: The help pages directly state that the email gate checks only the address format, not whether the mailbox exists, and that a nonexistent address still passes.

steps.text: No, Blotato checks the shape of the email address, not whether the mailbox exists.
A nonexistent address still passes the email gate.
